json.overall_experience: The Case Manager found Looker to be a powerful tool for tracking and analyzing company data, appreciating its ability to integrate various data sources and visualize insights. While the ease of use for consumption was a positive, the initial learning curve for LookML and perceived high cost were notable challenges during their first six months of use.
